{{Quote|Rhys, I'm counting on you making it through here. I know you can do this, so don't let me down.|Essara Till, to [[Rhys Dallows]], at the [[Naboo training canyon]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]</ref>}}
'''Essara Till''' was a [[Naboo  (people)/Legends|Naboo]]  [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]]. 
==Biography==
Essara was the daughter of famous and respected [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] government leaders.<ref name="stats">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=starfighter_stats|text="The Starfighter Trap" Character Statistics}}</ref> In her childhood she was educated according to the Naboo culture, focused on arts and philosophy, and was involved in weekly choral performances. However her instincts and talents urged her elsewhere, feeling her reflexes and tactical genius boiling inside her. At [[59 BBY/Legends|nine years old]] she quit the choral.

In [[49 BBY/Legends|49 BBY]], on the eve of her nineteenth birthday, she decided to pursue her own identity and left [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to see [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]; at first she made a living as a [[swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] pilot<ref name="stats" /> and [[46 BBY/Legends|eventually]] gained work as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]. In her career she spent 3 years flying a [[Z-95 AF-3 Headhunter]], the first of them being on a prototype, working on such [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] as [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]].

Dealing with pirates and [[Shipjacker/Legends|Shipjackers]], meeting the corruption and ruthlessness that pervaded the galaxy, she grew disillusioned and tried to keep away from greed and violence, unknown to the utopian harmony of her [[homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Eventually, while fighting [[pirate/Legends|pirates]] for the [[Garqi Agricultural Combine]] in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]] she felt homesick in the middle of a battle. 

Having spent more than a decade as a mercenary, she quit her job and returned home, and was welcomed back warmly by her parents.<ref name="stats" /> She started appreciating the things she used to shun in her youth, riding [[tusk cat]]s, camping and singing with friends.

She decided to purse her talents serving her homeworld. Soon after meeting [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]], he invited her to the Royal Naboo Security Forces, and she jumped at the opportunity. She refused the  honor of escorting [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|the Queen]] or other dignitaries, she preferred to stay planetside, flying patrols and imparting her precious knowledge and experience to the volunteers.<ref name="stats" />

She served as flight instructor for Bravo Flight, [[Echo Flight]], and [[Delta Flight]]. Quickly she joined the prestigious [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] where she met [[Dren Melne]]. an ex-mercenary pilot who returned to Naboo. Because of their background they would develop a friendship that would evolve into romantic feelings for each other and, by the [[34 BBY/Legends|next year]] they became lovers.  

At her 35 years Essara felt tired, and that, after completing her mission, she deserved to retire to a mountain cabin with Dren; who however laughed and the idea and insisted on returning to Agamar.

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Till was dealing with bureaucracy during the absence of [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] when there was an emergency. [[Station  TFP-9]] was raided by [[pirate/Legends|pirates]]. [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] and Melne briefed the pilots. Till flew as [[Bravo Seven]] (with [[R2-L1]]) and Dren as [[Bravo Eight]]. 12 [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruisers]] under [[Echo Flight]] were also dispatched and Till was the [[flight leader/Legends|Flight Leader]]. 

After Till hailed the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95]]s to order a ceasefire the fighters responded by engaging the two flight groups. Till would manage to shoot one down while Echo flight managed to handle the rest with minimal damage. Till then assigned [[Echo One]] and [[Echo Two (Echo Flight)|Two]] to join up in formation Zeta Nine with Bravo on an attack run to the [[Hornet-class carrier|''Hornet''-class carrier]]. However a new carrier showed up, with more Z-95s and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|unknown droid starfighters]].

It was then when Dren revealed that he wanted to turn against Naboo and started hitting on their own craft. She saw him shooting [[Kerl]]'s Echo Two and then moving against One. Till tried to get a lock on Dren's fighter, while admiring [[Evenyl Yob]]'s maneuvering to avoid him. Dren demanded that the Echo Flight should power down the ships, while inviting Essara to consider his invitation to join him. As Essara had a hard time putting Dren in her sights, she was shot by the mysterious droid starfighters, their shots overloading her shields. 

Her [[command monitor]] turned to black, and she had to redirect power from the lasers to shields. But when Dren launched torpedoes against Yob, Essara managed to shoot down one of them but did not enough laser power for both. As a result Essara ordered Yob to power her fighter systems down. In a private channel, she asked Dren to order the droid ships off her, and settle it personally, but Dren refused, citing that Essara was a better dogfighter than him anyway. Essara responded by launcing two torpedoes against him, only to be shot down by Dren's droid allies. While Essara evaded the droids, Dren satisfied her curiosity by narrating his motive: surrendering Naboo technology to his employer, in order to build his own a planetary defense force.

The fight ended with Dren's death.

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Till was [[Rhys Dallows]]'s superior in the Bravo Squadron mission to [[Attempted kidnapping of Queen Amidala|protect]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] during a rendezvous with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. She was killed by a [[Unidentified mercenary leader|mercenary]] hired by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].
